findings.title: Removing `findMany` breaks the service's existing query API
findings.body: The previous public `findMany(findManyArgs)` method is removed and replaced only with `getBaseConditions()`. Callers that currently use this service to retrieve booking rows will no longer type-check (or will fail at runtime if not type-checked), and the replacement does not preserve caller-supplied `select`, `where`, ordering, or pagination arguments. Migrate all consumers in the same change to execute an equivalent `$queryRaw` query, or retain a compatible `findMany` wrapper while introducing the SQL-condition API.
